gate: V=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin && $V/ruff check . && git ls-files | while read -r f; do case "$f" in .claude/*|.githooks/*|*.py|*.md|*.json|*.js|*.toml|*.yml|*.yaml) continue;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] && head -1 "$f" | grep -qE "^#!.*(/sh|bash)" && echo "$f"; done | xargs $V/shellcheck && make test
fast_check: V=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin && $V/ruff check . && PYTHONPATH=lib python3 -m unittest -f tests.test_adopt_doctor_finalize tests.test_human_only tests.test_secrets tests.test_workflows
